name: io.github.tonyyang0504/microsoft_advertising-mcp
description: Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, update_budget, pause_resu

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_ADVERTISING_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Application (client) id of the Microsoft Entra app registration used for the Microsoft Advertising consent.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_ADVERTISING_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The app's client secret; required for web apps, omit for native/public clients.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_ADVERTISING_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from the authorization-code flow with scope https://ads.microsoft.com/msads.manage offline_access; the runtime mints access tokens from it at https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_ADVERTISING_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Microsoft Advertising developer token (Developer Portal > Account), sent as the DeveloperToken header.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_ADVERTISING_CUSTOMER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Manager account (customer) id sent as the CustomerId header; list_accounts searches this customer's accounts.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_ADVERTISING_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Ad account id sent as the CustomerAccountId header; it must equal the AccountId in campaign calls, so pass the same id as list_campaigns' account_id.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_ADVERTISING_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = https://campaign.api.sandbox.bingads.microsoft.com. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_ADVERTISING_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.
